# Marker

A divider or status line inside a conversation, such as a date or someone joining.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-marker--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:light" title="Marker examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-marker--docs">Open Marker in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-marker--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** A date or event line in a long thread of notes on an alert. Not for a note someone wrote.

- **Use it when:** Breaking a long conversation into days or showing events in it.
- **Not when:** A message someone wrote.

Instead:

- [Message](./message.md): Something someone said.

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add marker
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Marker reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.

### Read straight from the system

Marker has no variables of its own yet; it reads these system tokens directly.
